text:
hana: quick design pass on compact playground controls. main asks: clarify Stop/regenerate copy, token counter loudness, prompt library keyboard affordances, a11y nits. dropping frames to the handoff board shortly.

leo: saw the frames. big UX risk is ambiguity about Stop semantics. users expect partial text to remain in most tests. keep the CTA short but make microcopy explicit.

irene: idea: primary label = "Stop". add a subtle caption beneath: "Keeps partial output for edit or regenerate". caption always exposed to screen readers; visible on hover/tap for sighted users.

hana: agree. for mobile long-press show an explicit menu with "Keep partial" (default) and "Discard". avoid hidden gestures as the only affordance.

morgan: token pill: VoiceOver/NVDA noisy while stream updates. debounce announcement to 220ms and use aria-live="polite" for increments, aria-live="assertive" for completion messages like "generation stopped". set interim animated numbers aria-hidden=true.

leo: add a tiny spinner in the pill while we reconcile server token count. spinner aria-hidden=true. also ensure the pill hit target is >=44px for touch and keyboard focus ring is clear in both themes.

irene: prompt library: change header from "Saved prompts" to "Prompt library". keyboard: arrow nav, Enter to insert, Space to pin. give each item role="button" and a visually-hidden label "Insert prompt: <title>". on insert show a polite toast: "Prompt inserted: <title> (editable)" with role=status and 3s timeout.

build-bot: staging flag compact-playground toggled at 2400001200. visual tests queued.

morgan: telemetry: unify stop/discard/regen under `playground.interrupt` with method enum {"stop","discard","regen"}. sample: `telemetry.track('playground.interrupt', { method: 'stop', visible_tokens: 24, variant: 'compact-v4' })`.

hana: good. regression risk: regen triggered while a stream is tearing down can double-charge in dedicated infra. filing INF-13042 for server idempotency key + client-side regen lock. mark P1 for billing exposure.

morgan: INF-13042 created. also note we should debounce token announcements only for live updates; final server reconciliation should update state immediately but with aria-live="assertive".

leo: small copy nits: Regen tooltip should read "Regenerate full response" (not "regen from start"). Stop tooltip: "Stop streaming — keeps partial output for edit or regenerate."

irene: a11y checklist for devs: stop caption + mobile menu, token pill debounce 220ms + spinner, pill hit-area >=44px + visible focus ring, prompt keyboard nav + hidden labels, toasts role=status 3s, telemetry rename, INF-13042. I'll run a VoiceOver pass once staging build lands.

hana: thanks all  pinning the landing checklist here.
